description: This file defines the QrSession entity class used for persisting QR code session data in a database, with fields for session status, timestamps, and related user information.

classes.name: QrSession
classes.description: Entity class representing a QR session with fields for session details, status, timestamps, and related user information.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Method annotated with @PrePersist to initialize UUID and creation timestamp before persisting to database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the UUID id of the QR session.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Setter for the UUID id of the QR session.

methods.name: getSessionToken
methods.description: Getter for the session token string.

methods.name: setSessionToken
methods.description: Setter for the session token string.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Getter for the associated User object.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Setter for the associated User object.

methods.name: getClientIp
methods.description: Getter for the client IP address.

methods.name: setClientIp
methods.description: Setter for the client IP address.

methods.name: getResultToken
methods.description: Getter for the optional result token (JWT).

methods.name: setResultToken
methods.description: Setter for the optional result token (JWT).
